info.title: VASP-FUSION
info.description: Nearest-VASP attribution for unknown crypto wallets, with calibrated confidence. SIH 2026 · PS 26182 · I4C.

post.description:
Sign in. The token comes back in the body and as an HttpOnly session cookie; either
is accepted on later requests. 401 for a wrong user name or password (the same words
for both), 429 while an account is locked after five wrong passwords.

Clear the session cookie. A token already handed out stays valid until it expires
(8 hours) or its account is disabled.

get.description: Who is signed in, and whether a login is required at all. Always answers.
The audit log, newest first: who looked up what, and when.

get.description:
The case file as an A4 PDF: result, summary, where the funds went, flow diagram,
exchanges reached with their evidence and transaction hashes, flags, how the
confidence was worked out, limitations, and the provenance receipt. The same case
always gives the same bytes. 409 until the case has a result. Also served at
/api/cases/{id}.pdf.

What the case was computed from, as SHA-256 digests: input, chain responses,
label database, model, code, and the findings fingerprint.

post.description:
Trace the wallet again from the cached chain responses only (never the network)
and compare the findings fingerprint with the receipt's.

get.description:
Everything on record about one address: its label, the cases it appears in, the
transfers those cases read of it, and what is on record against it (wallets.py).

How many labels the store holds, by chain, category, tier and source (with the
licence on record for each source).

The requests register: every request, newest first, withdrawn ones included.
The demo request is listed only while the desk itself is the mock.

patch.description:
Move a request along: drafted -> approved -> sent -> acknowledged -> answered |
freeze_confirmed | refused. 409 for a step that is not allowed from where it is.
Sending hands the payload and the letter to the gateway (a local outbox).

get.description:
The letter as an A4 PDF. A draft carries the watermark; the same request always
gives the same bytes. Also served at /api/requests/{id}.pdf.

Counted from the stored cases, the desk and the watchlist (dashboard.py). With no
stored case it answers the demo fixture, as the desk does.
Watched wallets, newest first, each compared with its baseline (watch.py).

post.description:
Trace the watched wallet again (as `POST /api/cases?refresh=true` does). Poll the
watchlist: the item is `checking` until the trace is done, then says what is new.
The officer has read the changes: the wallet's trace as it is now is the baseline.

get.description:
The deposit-address model's measurements (`make model`). Tron is the model whose
scores the labels carry; `?chain=ethereum` is the explorer-tagged benchmark.

wallets_named.title: Wallets Named
wallets_named.description: Wallets that get an exchange named at this bar

risk_upper_bound.title: Risk Upper Bound
risk_upper_bound.description: One-sided Clopper-Pearson bound on that risk, over wallets, corrected for the number of bars tried

AbstainBar.title: AbstainBar
AbstainBar.description:
One candidate bar: what naming an exchange only at or above it does on the
validation wallets.

measured_threshold.title: Measured Threshold
measured_threshold.description: Lowest bar whose wallet-level risk bound stays under target_risk; null when no bar on the grid does

AbstainInfo.title: AbstainInfo
AbstainInfo.description:
How the abstain bar was measured (B7): real exchange customers traced with the
derived labels hidden. Not a calibration; read `notes`.

officer.title: Officer
officer.description: User name; null = not signed in

target.title: Target
target.description: case id, `chain:address`, exchange name, request id, search text or user name, by action

status.title: Status
status.description: HTTP status of the reply (401 = refused, not signed in)

hash.title: Hash
hash.description: SHA-256 over this row and prev_hash

AuditEntry.title: AuditEntry
AuditEntry.description: One request to the API: who, what, on which case / wallet / exchange / request.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Separate from proximity. Label weight x hop decay x share factor. The label weight is the deposit-address model's calibrated probability where confidence_interval is set; otherwise every factor is rule-set

confidence_interval.title: Confidence Interval
confidence_interval.description: Set when the money reached a model-scored deposit address: the model's calibrated range, carried through the same formula. null = rule confidence only

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: outbound = the wallet's money went there; inbound = it funded the wallet

hops.title: Hops
hops.description: 0 = the wallet itself is a labelled VASP address

path.title: Path
path.description: Addresses from the suspect to deposit_address

counterfactual.title: Counterfactual
counterfactual.description: Named candidates only: what happens to this answer when the label on deposit_address (its strongest evidence) is hidden and the wallet is traced again
examples: Still CoinDCX without the label on TCw8j3…LLcoV5: 58% of the funds reach CoinDCX at TU7BbA…vZbsFs (curated list) in 2 hops, confidence 0.72 (was 0.85).

counterfactual_holds.title: Counterfactual Holds
counterfactual_holds.description: true: the same VASP is still named without that label. false: it falls under the bar or is not reached. null: not checked (the candidate was not named)

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: In the case's asset: the traced funds that reached this VASP (exact; share_of_funds is rounded)

request_wallets.title: Request Wallets
request_wallets.description: The wallets a request to this VASP lists, largest first; their amounts add up to `amount`. Empty for an inbound candidate and for the VASP's own wallet (hops 0). null in a case stored before B8: trace it again to route it to the desk

error.title: Error
error.description: Set when status is 'failed': what went wrong, in plain English

progress.description: Set only while status is queued or running and this server is tracing the case: poll the case to watch it. Never stored; null on a finished case

asset.title: Asset
asset.description: The asset that was traced, e.g. USDT

where_funds_went.title: Where Funds Went
where_funds_went.description: Adds up to the whole of `total_sent`; largest first

what_would_change.title: What Would Change
what_would_change.description: Evidence that would change an abstain

CaseInput.title: CaseInput
CaseInput.description: The question a case answers (everything else a trace depends on is code).

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: reading: the wallet's own transfers are being read. outbound: the money is being followed. inbound: the wallet's funders are being read. checking: the trace is done; each exchange that would be named is traced again without its label, and unlabelled wallets are scored

asset.title: Asset
asset.description: The asset being followed, once chosen

hop.title: Hop
hop.description: How many hops out the trace has gone

reached.title: Reached
reached.description: Labelled wallets the money has reached so far, each owner once, in the order found. Not a result: what is named is decided when the trace is done

message.title: Message
message.description: The same, as one sentence to show as it is

CaseProgress.title: CaseProgress
CaseProgress.description:
What a trace that is still running has read so far. Counts only: a trace does not
know how much is left, so there is no percentage.

error.title: Error
error.description: Set when status is 'failed': what went wrong, in plain English

median_time_to_attribution_s.title: Median Time To Attribution S
median_time_to_attribution_s.description: Median, over the cases that name an exchange, of the time the funds took to reach it (`time_to_reach_s` of the named candidate). null with no such case

open_cases.title: Open Cases
open_cases.description: Cases being traced, plus cases with a wallet routed to an exchange that has not replied yet (or has not been asked)

awaiting_request.title: Awaiting Request
awaiting_request.description: Exchanges with a routed wallet that no request asks about yet

unrequested_wallets.title: Unrequested Wallets
unrequested_wallets.description: Routed wallets of this VASP that no request asks about yet

field.title: Field
field.description: The directory field this source was read for

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: official: a government or regulator document. exchange: the exchange's own page. news: a press report. Show it: a self-reported fact is weaker

ExchangeFold.title: ExchangeFold
ExchangeFold.description: One row of the leave-one-exchange-out table: the model never saw this exchange.

total.title: Total
total.description: In `asset`; null when the transfers are in more than one asset

name.title: Name
name.description: The VASP or labelled party, when there is one

FundsSlice.title: FundsSlice
FundsSlice.description: One part of the answer to "where did the wallet's money end up?".

gateway.title: Gateway
gateway.description: `mock-outbox` until a real SAHYOG connection exists

location.title: Location
location.description: Where the submission went (the outbox file)

traced_amount.title: Traced Amount
traced_amount.description: The part of `amount` that is the suspect wallet's money

cluster.title: Cluster
cluster.description: VASP name when collapsible into one node

offline.title: Offline
offline.description: OFFLINE=1: chain data comes from the cache only

traced_amount.title: Traced Amount
traced_amount.description: The part of `amount` that is the suspect wallet's money

Hop.title: Hop
Hop.description: One step on the Hop Rail: money moved from `from_address` to `to_address`.

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: Chain slug as stored; 'evm' = any EVM chain

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: tier=derived only. With confidence_low/high set: the weight of the exchange wallet's label x the deposit-address model's calibrated probability (B6). Without them: the discovery rules' hand-set confidence, not calibrated

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: tier=derived only: what the sweep and gas-payer rules saw, and what the model said, in plain English

confidence_low.title: Confidence Low
confidence_low.description: Model-scored labels only: low end of the calibrated range (Venn-Abers)

model.description: Labels the deposit-address model scored: its own probability, range and reasons, whether or not the label's confidence is based on it

licence.title: Licence
licence.description: The licence on record for the set these rows were obtained from; null = not recorded in this project (show 'Not recorded', never a guess)

address.title: Address
address.description: The wallet the VASP is asked about, in full

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: Evidence tier of the label that names the VASP

first_seen.title: First Seen
first_seen.description: When the traced funds first reached this wallet

paid_into.title: Paid Into
paid_into.description: Set when `address` is not itself labelled: the VASP's labelled wallet it passed everything on to

label.title: Label
label.description: The label text behind the attribution

token.title: Token
token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The same token is set as an HttpOnly session cookie

flagged.title: Flagged
flagged.description: How many of them the model calls a deposit address

LookAlikes.title: LookAlikes
LookAlikes.description: The hard negatives: wallets that are not deposit addresses but forward as much.

auth_required.title: Auth Required
auth_required.description: false: no officer account exists (or login is switched off), so every route answers without one

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: The chain the model was trained on

abstain.description: How the bar below which no exchange is named was measured on this chain; null when it was not

feature.title: Feature
feature.description: The model feature, as a stable key

text.title: Text
text.description: What the address did, in plain English

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: SHAP value in log-odds: above 0 speaks for a deposit address, below 0 against

p.title: P
p.description: Calibrated probability that an address behaving like this is an exchange deposit address

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: model: the label's confidence is the model's value. rule: the model did not raise it, and the discovery rules' confidence is kept

scored_by.title: Scored By
scored_by.description: Which cross-fit model scored it; never one that trained on this address

ModelScore.title: ModelScore
ModelScore.description: What the deposit-address model said about one address (B6).

query.title: Query
query.description: The chain API request, API keys removed

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: SHA-256 of the response body as it was received

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: What this run did or could not do, e.g. how many unlabelled wallets the deposit-address model scored

responses.title: Responses
responses.description: Every chain API response this run read, each once, sorted by request

findings_sha256.title: Findings Sha256
findings_sha256.description: The findings fingerprint: every figure, address and transaction hash of the result, none of its wording. `verify` must reproduce it

content_sha256.title: Content Sha256
content_sha256.description: Digest of the whole result as stored, wording included: any edit to a stored case shows against it

model_version.title: Model Version
model_version.description: Set when the deposit-address model scored a wallet in this run, e.g. model_v1/tron

git_dirty.title: Git Dirty
git_dirty.description: true: the code had uncommitted changes

receipt_sha256.title: Receipt Sha256
receipt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of every other field of this document

Receipt.title: Receipt
Receipt.description:
What a case was computed from, as digests anyone can recompute. The same document
is the last page of the case file.

predicted.title: Predicted
predicted.description: Mean predicted probability in the bin

wallets.title: Wallets
wallets.description: Default: every wallet of this VASP in the cases

allowed_next.title: Allowed Next
allowed_next.description: The statuses a PATCH may move this request to now

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: The VASP's own published law-enforcement channel, from the directory

review_notes.title: Review Notes
review_notes.description: For the reviewing officer, not part of the request: what to check before approving. Printed on the draft PDF only

RequestList.title: RequestList
RequestList.description: The requests register: every request, newest first, withdrawn ones included.

address.title: Address
address.description: A labelled deposit address; or the unlabelled wallet that passed everything it got on to the VASP's wallet in paid_into; or the VASP's own labelled wallet

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Traced funds through this wallet, in the case's asset

paid_into.title: Paid Into
paid_into.description: Set when address carries no label: the VASP's labelled wallet it paid into

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: Of the label that names the VASP

reached_at.title: Reached At
reached_at.description: When the traced funds first reached address

tx_hashes.title: Tx Hashes
tx_hashes.description: The transfers that brought the funds to address and, for a pass-through wallet, on into the VASP's wallet; in time order

score.title: Score
score.description: Always null: no wallet risk score is computed. `level` is a plain rule

level.title: Level
level.description: high: the address is itself labelled sanctioned, mixer or scam, or a high-severity flag of a case names it. elevated: a pattern flag names it, or funds it sent reached a sanctioned or mixer address. none: nothing on record. null: not assessed (unlabelled and in no case)

RuleBaseline.title: RuleBaseline
RuleBaseline.description: What one rule alone scores on the test addresses: the bar the model must clear.

by.title: By
by.description: User name of the signed-in officer who made this change; null when no login was in force

code.title: Code
code.description: deposit_like is a lead from the deposit-address model on an unlabelled wallet (figures: p, low, high, share, amount); it never changes the outcome

fiu_ind_registered.title: Fiu Ind Registered
fiu_ind_registered.description: true: a source states it is registered with FIU-IND. false: FIU-IND named it as operating unregistered. null: no usable source. Always show with fiu_ind_as_of

fiu_ind_as_of.title: Fiu Ind As Of
fiu_ind_as_of.description: The date that source speaks for

le_request_channel.title: Le Request Channel
le_request_channel.description: The exchange's own published channel for law-enforcement requests (URL or email)

VaspDirectoryEntry.title: VaspDirectoryEntry
VaspDirectoryEntry.description:
`data/vasp_directory.yaml`: only facts with a source. A blank field means no
source was found, not "no".

routable.title: Routable
routable.description: false: shown for context only (under the bar, or the VASP funded the wallet); no request can be drafted on it

matches.title: Matches
matches.description: true only when the stored case still has its receipt's digests, the same responses were read, the new findings have the same fingerprint, and the new result has the same text (unless the code or the label database changed since)

VerifyResult.title: VerifyResult
VerifyResult.description: A stored case traced again from the cached chain responses only, and compared.

flows_from_cases.title: Flows From Cases
flows_from_cases.description: How many stored cases `inbound` and `outbound` were read from. They are the transfers those traces read, not the wallet's whole history

WatchItem.title: WatchItem
WatchItem.description:
A watched wallet, compared with its baseline: the trace it had when it was added
or when its changes were last marked as seen.
